arxiv-2202-04836.title: Deconstructing the Inductive Biases of Hamiltonian Neural Networks
arxiv-2202-04836.creator: Nate Gruver, Marc Finzi, Samuel Stanton, Andrew Gordon Wilson
arxiv-2202-04836.description: Abstract Physics-inspired neural networks (NNs), such as Hamiltonian or Lagrangian NNs, dramatically outperform other learned dynamics models by leveraging strong inductive biases. These models, however, are challenging to apply to many real world systems, such as those that don’t conserve energy or contain contacts, a common setting for robotics and reinforcement learning.

arxiv-2311-00868.title: Towards a complete classification of 6D supergravities
arxiv-2311-00868.creator: Yuta Hamada, and Gregory J. Loges
arxiv-2311-00868.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yuta Hamada, and Gregory J. Loges. The constraints arising from anomaly cancellation are particular strong for chiral theories in six dimensions. We make progress towards a complete classification of 6D supergravities with minimal supersymmetry and non-abelian gauge group. First, we generalize a previously known infinite class of anomaly-free theories which has T ≫ 9 T\gg 9 to essentially any semi-simple gauge group and infinitely many choices for hypermultiplets.

arxiv-2410-13031.title: A Location Validation Technique to Mitigate GPS Spoofing Attacks in IEEE 802.11p based Fleet Operator’s Network of Electric Vehicles
arxiv-2410-13031.creator: Ankita Samaddar, Arvind Easwaran
arxiv-2410-13031.description: Abstract Most vehicular applications in electric vehicles use IEEE 802.11p protocol for vehicular communications. Vehicle rebalancing application is one such application that has been used by many car rental service providers to overcome the disparity between vehicle demand and vehicle supply at different charging stations.

arxiv-2504-15938.title: Differentiable graph neural network simulator for forward and inverse modeling of multi-layered slope system with multiple material properties
arxiv-2504-15938.creator: Yongjin Choi, Jorge Macedo, Chenying Liu
arxiv-2504-15938.description: Abstract Graph neural network simulators (GNS) have emerged as a computationally efficient tool for simulating granular flows. Previous efforts have been limited to simplified homogeneous geometries characterized only by the friction angle, which does not reflect the complexity of realistic slopes encountered in engineering practice.

arxiv-2509-21433.title: DyME: Dynamic Multi-Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models with Bi-level Orthogonal LoRA Adaptation
arxiv-2509-21433.creator: Jiaqi Liu, Lan Zhang, Xiaoyong Yuan
arxiv-2509-21433.description: Abstract Text-to-image diffusion models (DMs) inadvertently reproduce copyrighted styles and protected visual concepts, raising legal and ethical concerns. Concept erasure has emerged as a safeguard, aiming to selectively suppress such concepts through fine-tuning. However, existing methods do not scale to practical settings where providers must erase multiple and possibly conflicting concepts.

arxiv-2605-23520.title: Network Attractors driven by Time-Delay Plasticity Preprint: APS/123-QED
arxiv-2605-23520.creator: Stefan Ruschel, Emanuil Hristov, Hil G.E. Meijer, Stephen Coombes, Rachel Nicks

pmc-10692907.title: Comparison of properties of multilayer film sputtered on glass and polypropylene substrates with angular DC magnetron Co-sputtering system
pmc-10692907.creator: Preecha Changyom, Komgrit Leksakul, Dheerawan Boonyawan, Pongsawat Premphet, Norrapon Vichiansan
pmc-10692907.description: Complex multilayer film structures were fabricated through a custom-built angular DC magnetron co-sputtering system. In this system, separate Cu, Al, and brass (Cu + Zn) targets were mounted on three magnetron guns, working in conjunction with a rotating substrate. This study aimed to compare the properties of films with intricate structures, which were sputtered onto glass slides and polypropylene substrates.

pmc-11360089.title: Response Surface Modelling Nafion-117 Sorption of Tetraammineplatinum(II) Chloride in the Electroless Plating of IPMCs
pmc-11360089.creator: Eyman Manaf, Golnoosh Abdeali, Sean Reidy, Clement L Higginbotham, John G Lyons, Brian J Edwards
pmc-11360089.description: This work looks at the effects of a varying concentration, soak time, pH and temperature on the sorption of tetraammineplatinum(II) chloride (Pt-Ammine) in Nafion-117 films in the context of the electroless plating of ionic polymer–metal composites (IPMCs). Sorption is characterised by atomic absorption spectroscopy.

pmc-11496517.title: Expression and functional divergence of a type-A response regulator paralog pair formed by dispersed duplication during Populus deltoides evolution
pmc-11496517.creator: Jing Lu, Ying-nan Chen, Tong-ming Yin
pmc-11496517.description: Gene duplication and divergence are essential to plant evolution. The Arabidopsis type-A response regulator (ARR) family, negative regulators in cytokinin signaling, exemplifies gene expansion and differential retention. Despite extensive research, the understanding of type-A RR homologs in woody plants remains limited.

pmc-11600556.title: Identification of fungal pathogens among COVID-19 and non COVID-19 cases in Bhaktapur hospital, Nepal
pmc-11600556.creator: Asmita Lamichhane, Sushma Regmi, Krishma Pandit, Sweety Upadhaya, Jyoti Acharya, Srijana Koirala, Shreedhar Aryal, Krishna Gurung, Jiwan Thapa, Sanjib Adhikari, Suprina Sharma, Pramod Poudel, Supriya Sharma
pmc-11600556.description: ObjectivesPatients with coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) are at increased risk of opportunistic fungal infections. This study aims to identify fungal pathogens among COVID positive and negative patients, assess their antifungal susceptibility and evaluate biofilm forming ability of Candida spp. A cross-sectional study was conducted among sputum samples from 135 COVID positive and 101 COVID negative cases.

pmc-11773584.title: Author Response: Before the Stump Flow on the TCD in SAH can be Attributed to an SAH Relapse all Other Possible Causes must be Ruled Out
pmc-11773584.creator: Ripenmeet Salhotra
pmc-11773584.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). How to cite this article: Salhotra R. Author Response: Before the Stump Flow on the TCD in SAH can be Attributed to an SAH Relapse all Other Possible Causes must be Ruled Out.

pmc-12470925.title: How Does the Interaction Between Preterm Delivery and Low Birthweight Contribute to Racial Disparity in Infant Mortality in the United States?
pmc-12470925.creator: James Thompson, Francisco Guillen-Grima
pmc-12470925.description: Background/Objectives: In the United States, Black infants are twice as likely as infants of all other races and ethnicities to die by one year of age. Mediation modeling predicted that preventing low birthweight could alleviate 75% of this disparity. However, the potential confounding and interacting role of preterm birth remains a question.

pmc-12549544.title: Comparative analyses of dynamic transcriptome profiles reveal that DUSP1 regulates myogenic differentiation and muscle fiber type transformation
pmc-12549544.creator: F Peng, ZH Song, K Xie, L Chang, D Zhao, Y Cui, X He
pmc-12549544.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Modern breeding strategies have engendered pronounced disparities in muscle mass and quality between indigenous chickens and specialized broilers. Despite these observable phenotypic differences, the molecular regulatory mechanisms that underpin these variations remain largely uncharacterized. The objective of this study was to elucidate the key genes and regulatory pathways that govern the differential development of pectoral muscle between indigenous chickens and specialized broilers.

pmc-12584086.title: Sustainable Tax-Based Financing Strategies in the Health Care System: A Scoping Review
pmc-12584086.creator: Ghasem Taheri, Hassan Abolghasem Gorji, Aziz Rezapor, Mehdi Jafari Sirizi, Masoud Behzadifar
pmc-12584086.description: BackgroundThe main advantage of tax-based financing is its sustainability, as well as the participation of all members of society, regardless of their health status, risk pooling, and the spread of risk among members of society. Therefore, the aim of the present study is a comprehensive review of sustainable tax-based financing strategies in the health system.

pmc-13233884.title: Postnatal water immersion after perinatal death: a clinical study of appearance preservation and autopsy validity
pmc-13233884.creator: Teresa Starrach, Jens H. L. Neumann, Lucia Ehmann, Laura Hahn, Esther Schouten, Sven Kehl, Sven Mahner, Uwe Hasbargen, Sarah Soliman, Christoph Hübener
pmc-13233884.description: ObjectivePerinatal loss is an emotionally devastating event for affected families. In some clinical settings, postnatal immersion of perinatally deceased infants in water is used to preserve the infant’s external appearance and facilitate parental farewell. The objective of this study was to evaluate possible effects of this practice on autopsy findings and diagnostic validity.

pmc-13654173.title: Vessel wall MRI predictors of postprocedural new ischemic brain lesions after endovascular treatment for basilar artery stenosis
pmc-13654173.creator: Wanda Shi, Hao Wang, Tao Wang, Shuaiwei Guo, Long Li, Yabing Wang, Peng Gao, Yanfei Chen, Jian Chen, Fei Chen, Bin Yang, Yan Ma, Yanxin Zhao, Jichang Luo, Liqun Jiao
pmc-13654173.description: BackgroundDiffusion-weighted imaging (DWI)-detected new ischemic brain lesions (NIBL) are common complications after endovascular treatment (EVT) for basilar artery stenosis (BAS), directly impacting functional outcomes in patients. This study aimed to explore the association between vulnerable plaque markers identified by high-resolution magnetic resonance imaging (HR-MRI) and NIBL, and to clarify their predictive value for postprocedural ischemic events.

uslaw-usc-t16-s445b.title: 16 U.S.C. § 445b — Administration by National Park Service; powers and duties
uslaw-usc-t16-s445b.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s445b.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 1 (National Parks, Military Parks, Monuments, And Seashores); Subchapter LXI (National And International Monuments And Memorials). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The National Park Service, under the direction of the Secretary of the Interior, is charged with the administration of the area of said national monument, so far as it applies to the care, maintenance.
